notes.title: v1.1 is here!
notes.content:
- Steam username is used for Leaderboards from now on
- Steam account linked automatically to game account
- New Skin: Animals
- Fix: fruits doesn't stick to the side of the jar anymore making the game end suddenly
- Fix: game icon resolution
- minor UI polishing

notes.title: 1.0.2 Release Notes
notes.content:
v1.0.2
- Leaderboards display the top 100 for all periods (Daily, Weekly, Monthly and All Time)
- Now players can see their position and score on all rank periods, even if they are not in top 100.
- fixed Cloud flickering when playing using Mouse

notes.title: 1.0.1 Release Notes
notes.content:
Thank you so much for playing our game! Here is the list of the improvements we did by hearing your feedback:

- Game Over now triggers at the correct time.
- Now players can adjust sound settings from the main menu. 

We have more to come! Thank you!
